title: OP BOYS VS GIRLS SCRIPT! [Open Source]
description:
OP SCRIPT WITH 5+ FEATURES

AUTO KILL,
TEAM KILL

Updates coming soon! 👀👀👀👀
scriptContent:
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- 1. CLEANUP
local oldUI = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Xeno_Pro_Fixed")
if oldUI then oldUI:Destroy() end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
ScreenGui.Name = "Xeno_Pro_Fixed"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- 2. UI SETUP
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 420) -- Widened to fit more lists
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -260, 0.5, -210)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame)

local function createScroll(pos, titleText)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", MainFrame)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 20)
    label.Position = pos - UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25)
    label.Text = titleText
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    
    local scf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", MainFrame)
    scf.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 150)
    scf.Position = pos
    scf.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    scf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 5, 0)
    scf.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    Instance.new("UIListLayout", scf).Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    return scf
end

-- Lists
local TeamScroll = createScroll(UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 70), "TARGET TEAM")
local PlayerScroll = createScroll(UDim2.new(0, 185, 0, 70), "TARGET PLAYER")
local WeaponScroll = createScroll(UDim2.new(0, 355, 0, 70), "WEAPON")

-- Mode Toggle Button
local targetMode = "Team" -- Defaults to Team
local ModeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", MainFrame)
ModeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 490, 0, 30)
ModeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)
ModeBtn.Text = "MODE: TEAM"
ModeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
ModeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Instance.new("UICorner", ModeBtn)

local HuntBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", MainFrame)
HuntBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 490, 0, 50)
HuntBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 260)
HuntBtn.Text = "START HUNTING"
HuntBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
HuntBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Instance.new("UICorner", HuntBtn)

local BlackBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", MainFrame)
BlackBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 490, 0, 40)
BlackBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 320)
BlackBtn.Text = "BLACKLIST CURRENT AREA"
BlackBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 0)
BlackBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Instance.new("UICorner", BlackBtn)

-- 3. LOGIC VARIABLES
local hunting = false
local selectedTeam = nil
local selectedPlayer = nil
local selectedWeapon = ""
local blacklistedZones = {}
local blacklistRadius = 30

-- 4. VISUAL BLACKLIST
local function createVisualZone(pos)
    local sphere = Instance.new("Part")
    sphere.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    sphere.Position = pos
    sphere.Size = Vector3.new(blacklistRadius * 2, blacklistRadius * 2, blacklistRadius * 2)
    sphere.Anchored = true
    sphere.CanCollide = false
    sphere.Transparency = 0.7
    sphere.Color = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    sphere.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
    sphere.Parent = workspace
end

-- 5. LIST UPDATER
local function updateLists()
    -- Clear buttons
    for _, v in pairs(TeamScroll:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("TextButton") then v:Destroy() end end
    for _, v in pairs(PlayerScroll:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("TextButton") then v:Destroy() end end
    for _, v in pairs(WeaponScroll:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("TextButton") then v:Destroy() end end
    
    -- Teams
    for _, t in pairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton", TeamScroll)
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
        b.Text = t.Name
        b.BackgroundColor3 = (selectedTeam == t) and Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
            selectedTeam = t
            selectedPlayer = nil -- Clear player if team is picked
            updateLists() 
        end)
    end
    
    -- Players
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player then
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", PlayerScroll)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
            b.Text = p.DisplayName
            b.BackgroundColor3 = (selectedPlayer == p) and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
                selectedPlayer = p
                selectedTeam = nil -- Clear team if player is picked
                updateLists() 
            end)
        end
    end
    
    -- Weapons
    local items = player.Backpack:GetChildren()
    if player.Character then 
        for _, i in pairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do 
            if i:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(items, i) end 
        end 
    end
    
    for _, tool in pairs(items) do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") then
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", WeaponScroll)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
            b.Text = tool.Name
            b.BackgroundColor3 = (selectedWeapon == tool.Name) and Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() selectedWeapon = tool.Name updateLists() end)
        end
    end
end

updateLists()

-- 6. BUTTON ACTIONS
ModeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if targetMode == "Team" then
        targetMode = "Player"
        ModeBtn.Text = "MODE: PLAYER"
    else
        targetMode = "Team"
        ModeBtn.Text = "MODE: TEAM"
    end
end)

HuntBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    hunting = not hunting
    HuntBtn.Text = hunting and "KILLING..." or "START HUNTING"
    HuntBtn.BackgroundColor3 = hunting and Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
end)

BlackBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root then
        table.insert(blacklistedZones, root.Position)
        createVisualZone(root.Position)
    end
end)

-- 7. THE ENGINE
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if hunting and selectedWeapon ~= "" then
            local char = player.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            
            if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local targetChar = nil
                
                if targetMode == "Team" and selectedTeam then
                    -- Find nearest/any valid person in that team
                    for _, v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if v ~= player and v.Team == selectedTeam and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            local tRoot = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                            local tHum = v.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                            
                            if tHum and tHum.Health > 0 then
                                local inBlacklist = false
                                for _, zonePos in pairs(blacklistedZones) do
                                    if (tRoot.Position - zonePos).Magnitude < blacklistRadius then
                                        inBlacklist = true; break
                                    end
                                end
                                
                                if not inBlacklist then
                                    targetChar = v.Character
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                elseif targetMode == "Player" and selectedPlayer then
                    -- Target specific player
                    if selectedPlayer.Character and selectedPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                        local tHum = selectedPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                        if tHum and tHum.Health > 0 then
                            targetChar = selectedPlayer.Character
                        end
                    end
                end

                if targetChar then
                    local tool = char:FindFirstChild(selectedWeapon) or player.Backpack:FindFirstChild(selectedWeapon)
                    if tool then
                        if tool.Parent == player.Backpack then hum:EquipTool(tool) end
                        root.CFrame = targetChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                        tool:Activate()
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
